jobs.title: [ops] bm-a 自唤醒安装 + 邻居可达性探测
jobs.cmd: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File Tools/fleet/selfwake.ps1 -Node bm-a; powershell -Command "Test-NetConnection 100.82.175.0 -Port 5985 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty TcpTestSucceeded" > cph4/fleet/queue-receipts/SELFWAKE-BMA-195051.txt

jobs.title: [self-heal] bm-a 分叉收口（reset 到 origin/main，先留备份分支）
